themes.evidence: We are using our competitive advantages to further strengthen our brand. Our growth pillars build on our strong foundations to ensure we can meet the moment today and have long-term success.
Ray Kroc’s original commitment to Quality, Service, Cleanliness and Value has endured and made McDonald’s a trusted favorite for over 65 years.

Our mission is to make delicious feel-good moments easy for everyone. The backbone of our Brand is, and always has been, a commitment to a set of core values that define who we are and how we run our business and restaurants.

Behind our Golden Arches is a global community of crew, farmers, suppliers, franchisees, and countless others who make up who we are as a brand. It’s the entire McFamily that makes McDonald’s what it is today and what it’s been for over 65 years.
What matters to our customers, matters to McDonald’s, so our vision for the future centers around five core values: Community, Inclusion, Family, Service and Integrity.

linguistic_shift: The page emphasizes community, inclusion, and family values more prominently than before, reflecting a broader focus on social impact and employee well-being.
